title: Vanishing of a current on test forms supported off its support (G1)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, T ∈ D_n(U) a current (GeometricCurrentOn U n) and ω ∈ D^n(U) a test form (TestFormOn U n). If tsupport ω is disjoint from spt T (T.support = U ∖ zeroRegion(T), Simon Ch. 6, 2.11), then T(ω) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n)) T.support → T ω = 0
